notes: Hyphen-grouped 16-digit booking reference that fails Luhn (verified: computed Luhn is False). The combination is the point — a detector that strips separators to find a 16-digit candidate but skips checksum validation fires here, and one that validates without stripping separators never forms a candidate at all. Only stripping AND validating gives the right answer. Being Luhn-invalid also makes the value provably not a real card
